D005-D015_h001.question: It all started about two months ago. I've been feeling so low, just completely drained and unable to find enjoyment in anything, even the things I used to love about nursing. But honestly, the feeling that I'm being watched and the strange metallic taste started first and have been pretty constant, regardless of how low I’m feeling.
